answer_1.quote: Counterfactual story generation aims to revise an original story ending guided by a modified condition.

answer_2.quote: For Timetravel, we follow the previous works and use BLEU, BertScore, ENTScore, and HMean = 2•BLEU•ENTScore BLEU+ENTScore as metrics.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are recruited to make a preference among Win, Tie, and Lose given the input and two outputs generated by our model and a baseline respectively.
answer_4.guideline: We carry out pairwise comparisons between our method with some baselines... make a preference among Win, Tie, and Lose
